question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given word.

Pugnacious
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Waspish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"pugnacious"** means eager or quick to argue, quarrel, or fight. (लड़ाकू)

 
 
• **Example: **The pugnacious student was always ready to debate with his teachers.
 
 
 
• **"Waspish"** refers to someone who is readily expressing anger or irritation. (क्रोधी)
 
 
• **Example: **Her waspish comments made the discussion very tense and uncomfortable.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Waspish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Impatient **(अधीर): Having or showing a tendency to be quickly irritated or provoked.

 
 
• **Example:** He was becoming increasingly impatient as he waited for the test results.
 
 
 
• **Good-tempered **(मिलनसार): Having a cheerful and pleasant disposition.
 
 
• **Example: **She is known to be good-tempered, always smiling and kind.
 
 
 
• **Arrogant** (घमंडी): Having or revealing an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities.
 
 
• **Example:** His arrogant attitude made him unpopular among his peers.
